Full Feature Reference

Fighting Style

You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. This sample keeps the full text short; replace it with the complete wording you want in the printed book.

Second Wind

You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on to protect yourself during a fight.

Action Surge

You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment and take an additional action.

Combat Superiority

You learn maneuvers fueled by superiority dice. Record the chosen maneuvers and their complete text here.

Ability Score Improvement

You can increase ability scores or choose a feat, depending on the rules used by the campaign.

Extra Attack

You can attack more than once when taking the Attack action on your turn.

Know Your Enemy

You can study another creature and learn information about its capabilities.

Indomitable

You can reroll a saving throw that you fail.

Improved Combat Superiority

Your superiority dice become stronger.

Extra Attack (2)

You can attack three times when taking the Attack action on your turn.

Indomitable (2)

You can use Indomitable twice between rests.

Relentless

You regain a superiority die when initiative starts and you have none remaining.

Action Surge (2)

You can use Action Surge twice between rests, but only once on the same turn.

Indomitable (3)

You can use Indomitable three times between rests.

Improved Combat Superiority (2)

Your superiority dice increase again for the highest-tier play.

Extra Attack (3)

You can attack four times when taking the Attack action on your turn.
